tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidder/Tenderer should provide standard good quality of food
Bidder/Tenderer should provide different variety of tiffin daily as per enclosed BID Estimate
Payment will be made according to the financial conditions on availability of fund.
CMC holds the authority of Accepting and rejecting of tender
Bidder/Tenderer should Enclose local address proof
Bidder/Tenderer should Enclose Trade License Certificate 2025-26
Bidder/Tenderer should Annual Turnover Certificate of Previous 2 years
